basic_info.description: Just steps to Alamo Square and the many chic cafes, restaurants and shops in vibrant NoPa, this sunny southeast corner 2 bedroom 2 bathroom condo in a contemporary elevator building has it ALL!        The inviting entry welcomes you to the grand living room (with cozy wood burning fireplace and office nook) that is flooded with light from the wall of south-facing windows. The chef's kitchen features top-of-the-line stainless appliances, granite counters, abundant custom cabinetry and breakfast bar adjacent to the large formal dining area.    The huge primary suite offers downtown views, full remodeled en-suite bathroom, large closet and sitting area.  A spacious 2nd bedroom, full hallway bathroom, in-unit laundry, new designer lighting, beautiful wood floors, high ceilings, dual-paned windows throughout, 1 car parking and much more make this a very special place to call home.    Close to transportation corridors and tech shuttles.
